entries.name: schema:PolicyConfirmationLifecycle@v1
entries.reason: cio_r13_institution.confirm_policy_lifecycle has no caller; policy confirmation goes through cio_operator_investment_policy.ratify_policy_field (surfaced as policy provenance). Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:PolicyProvenance@v1
entries.reason: Material-scan audit that a default cash band is not passed off as operator policy (audit_cash_posture_policy); the operator-facing provenance is the policy provenance view + registry (surfaced).

entries.name: schema:ProviderRequestJournal@v1
entries.reason: Durable LLM provider request journal (cio_provider_retry_v1.reserve/record, cio_governed_model_bridge) for idempotent retries; provider plumbing.

entries.name: schema:ResearchBudget@v1
entries.reason: Per-instrument daily research budget ledger (cio_research_budget.record/select) for the wake dispatcher; spend control plumbing, reported by cio_research_budget_report.py.

entries.name: schema:ResearchDecisionLink@v1
entries.reason: cio_intelligence_outcomes.link_research_decision has no caller (module imported only by check_dark_contracts.py); research->decision links are recorded by intelligence_lineage instead. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:ResearchHistory@v1
entries.reason: Prior research outcomes per plan read from the request stream (cio_research_history) for the research gate and S0 loop; gate input, research results themselves are surfaced via research provenance.

entries.name: schema:ResearchImpact@v1
entries.reason: Research-completion impacts written to cio_research_impacts.jsonl by cio_product_reassessment.research_impact are joined by build_hermes_research_links into items[].decision_ids, which the Hermes decision-links panel renders on the Hermes and Research Intelligence hubs.

entries.name: schema:ResearchPreflight@v1
entries.reason: Preflight that loads an InstrumentRecord before ResearchNeedDecision.decide (decide_after_load) in the wake dispatcher; gate plumbing.

entries.name: schema:ResearchScheduleSurface@v1
entries.reason: Schedule surface of the research routing gate (cio_research_gate.schedule_surface) used only by cio_research_gate_report.py; routing internals.

entries.name: schema:ResidualWebLane@v1
entries.reason: Residual web lane that executes the gate's residual rung (cio_residual_web legality/run_hop); search-lane plumbing and legality checks.

entries.name: schema:RetryDisposition@v1
entries.reason: Canonical retry disposition for a failed provider call (cio_provider_retry_v1.classify_failure); retry policy plumbing.

entries.name: schema:S0OperatorTurn@v1
entries.reason: Record of one S0 operator-loop turn (cio_s0_operator_loop._turn) minted for Telegram converse memory; conversation bookkeeping, not CIO judgment.

entries.name: schema:S0RehydrateBundle@v1
entries.reason: Bundle the S0 loop rehydrates for the next conversation turn (cio_s0_operator_loop.rehydrate); transient agent context.

entries.name: schema:SameBrainAcceptance@v1
entries.reason: Both definitions are uncalled: cio_context_envelope_v2.same_brain lives in a module nothing imports, and cio_intelligence_fabric.same_brain_institutional has no caller. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:ScanFabricOverlay@v1
entries.reason: Overlay that the material scan writes into the fabric (observe_from_scan via cio_material_scan); scan plumbing, situations are surfaced via OfficeSituationScan@v1.

entries.name: schema:ShadowExperiment@v1
entries.reason: cio_institutional_learning.shadow_experiment has no caller; shadow experiments are tracked by other stores (shadow_experiments.jsonl), not this builder. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:SituationNotifyBridge@v1
entries.reason: Bridge receipt feeding CIOSituationState@v1 into the production notification chokepoint (cio_situation_notify_bridge, via cio_material_scan); the situations and notification block are surfaced.

entries.name: schema:SourceLibrarian@v1
entries.reason: Source shelf-life audit for graded sources (cio_research_librarian.audit/filter_corpus) applied inside the research gate; corpus hygiene.

entries.name: schema:SpecialistArtifact@v1
entries.reason: cio_r13_institution.specialist_artifact is called only by score_specialist_readiness inside the same module, which itself has no caller; runtime specialist artifacts come from cio_specialist_artifact. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:SpecialistDisagreementMemory@v1
entries.reason: cio_intelligence_outcomes.specialist_disagreement_memory has no caller; the Operator-evidence 'specialist disagreement' capability reports DARK for exactly this reason. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:SpecialistRuntimeArtifact@v1
entries.reason: cio_intelligence_outcomes.specialist_runtime_artifact has no caller; specialist artifacts are written by cio_specialist_artifact, not this dark module. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:SpecialistRuntimeResult@v1
entries.reason: cio_intelligence_outcomes.specialist_unavailable has no caller in scripts/; the specialist runtime result contract never leaves the dark module. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:WakeSubjectDecision@v1
entries.reason: Decision that gives a wake its subject before loading the record (cio_wake_subject.decide) in the wake dispatcher; dispatch plumbing.

entries.name: schema:WakeTurnEffect@v1
entries.reason: Per-turn effect row of a wake (cio_rehydrate._record_turn_effect -> wake_turn_effects.jsonl) used by the research budget; agent bookkeeping.

entries.name: schema:WatchInstrumentAdmit@v1
entries.reason: Receipt of admitting WATCH InstrumentRecord rows (admit_watch_records, cognition only) during record migration; migration job output.

entries.name: schema:WebEvidenceProvenance@v1
entries.reason: cio_intelligence_fabric.persist_web_evidence has no caller in scripts/; web evidence provenance is surfaced through the research-provenance route instead. Do not delete without an archive tripwire (AGENTS rule 6).

entries.name: schema:WebSourceRef@v1
entries.reason: Librarian-lite reference for one web source used by the residual web lane (cio_web_librarian.source_ref/summarize); citation plumbing, provenance is surfaced via research provenance.

entries.name: schema:CIOCapitalPlanDecision@v1
entries.reason: Append-only audit record of each capital-plan position decision id (cio_capital_plan_decision_store), read by the decision-lineage endpoint so a churned id stays resolvable; the decision itself is surfaced by the capital-plan / CIO NOW table and its stages by the decision-lineage panel.

entries.name: schema:StageApplicability@v1
entries.reason: Contract label only, not a payload: cio_stage_applicability.not_applicable_reason returns a reason string prefixed with it, and that string is surfaced verbatim as the stage state_reason inside CIODecisionLineage@v1 on the decision-lineage panel. No StageApplicability block is produced or persisted.

entries.name: schema:CIOPlanExpiry@v1
entries.reason: Audit receipt appended by scripts/expire_stale_cio_plans.py (counts and expired plan ids per run). Its effect is surfaced where the operator looks: the CIO Desk Decisions card's open-plan count, and each expired plan's status_reason on the plan itself.

entries.name: schema:OpportunityProjection@v1
entries.reason: Investment Command Center (operator plan approved 2026-10-08, PR #1516): the latest curated ranking of ~1,400 OpportunityAssessment@v1 rows, written to data/cio/cio_opportunity_projection.json by scripts/cio_opportunity_curator.py through CIOOpportunityStore.write_projection. Served by GET /api/v3/opportunities and rendered in Watch > Opportunities and the Home Top opportunities widget; the Telegram opportunity line reads it too.

entries.name: schema:OpportunityAssessmentVersion@v1
entries.reason: Append-only CIO-memory version history (data/cio/cio_opportunity_assessments.jsonl) of the same assessment the operator sees through schema:OpportunityProjection@v1; a version is written only on a material change and exists for audit and learning. The opportunity modal shows only the version count and change reasons, read via CIOOpportunityStore.history.

entries.name: schema:LlmRoutingPolicy@v1
entries.reason: Server-side map from a registered process id to a provider lane (config/llm_routing_policy.json), read only by the governed model bridge. The operator does not read this document. A call's chosen lane is on that call's routing_decision receipt; an unknown policy or an unhealthy lane is a typed refusal, not a CIO surface.

entries.name: schema:BridgeCallerAuthReport@v1
entries.reason: Report-only diagnostic of guardrail audit B H2 report mode (TRADEAI_BRIDGE_CALLER_AUTH=report, the default): an infrastructure rollout record (data/runtime/bridge_caller_auth_report.jsonl, one line per unverified bridge caller per hour) listing which governed-bridge callers still need a TRADEAI_BRIDGE_CALLER_KEY_<CALLER> before enforce mode. It carries caller names, verdicts and key env names only, no investment content; the operator reads it as an ops checklist (and the counter on the bridge's GET /health), not through a CIO surface.

entries.name: schema:EgressSanitiserReport@v1
entries.reason: Report-only diagnostic of the AGENTS.md §2A single egress sanitiser (sanitise_for_external, §23.10 P4; TRADEAI_EGRESS_SANITISER=report, the default): one line per governed-bridge call whose outbound messages matched a §2A category (data/runtime/egress_sanitiser_report.jsonl). It carries process id, request id, mode, action and per-category counts only, never content or a matched value, and no investment content; the operator reads it as the evidence for moving report to enforce (and the counter on the bridge's GET /health), not through a CIO surface.

entries.name: schema:EgressSanitiserPolicy@v1
entries.reason: Rules-as-data for the AGENTS.md §2A single egress sanitiser (config/egress_sanitiser_policy.json): the categories and regular expressions sanitise_for_external() applies before every governed-bridge provider call, plus the §2A permitted set as documentation. Read only by scripts/lib/cio_egress_sanitiser.py; a change is a reviewed config PR. No investment content and no operator surface.
